newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices static, bund spread edges in.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices static, bund spread edges in.

text.p: Danish benchmark bond prices trod water throughout Tuesday morning in low turnover with players staying on the sidelines ahead of this afternoon's U.S. NAPM data.

Dealers said that the Danish market was currently fairly independent of the U.S. and German markets and a fall in their prices was likely to further narrow the shrinking Danish-German 10-year yield gap.
"If the (NAPM) data bring American bonds down, the Danish-German spread will close further toward 55 basis points," a dealer said.
